Conditions of application

  • Fares only apply if purchased before departure except when used for en-route upgrading from a lower fare or reissue of the same fare basis provided all conditions of these fares are met. The fare basis is defined as the fare basis code disregarding numerical variations. For example JUQ2 is the same fare basis as JUQ1 for reissue/upgrade purposes.
  • Taxes - all appropriate taxes are to be collected.
  • Fares and conditions are subject to change/cancellation without notice.
  • Downgrade of booking class not permitted after ticket issue.
  • Ticket not valid unless issued with a tour code.
  • Passenger expenses are not permitted.
  • Groups not permitted - Contact QF Group Sales.
Tickets can be reissued from QF operated flights to JQ operated flights and from JQ operated flights to QF operated flights

Fares

  • Fares for this corporate deal have been filed as private fares to allow auto quoting and ticketing.
  • All fares must be ticketed as per the GDS to avoid an ADM being issued.
  • Fares are available from Australian board points (excluding HID, WEI, WTB, BCI, BKQ, CTL, LDH, LRE,RMA, MRZ, GOV, KNX) to the applicable end destination subject to availability of an eligible published through fare.

Base Fares / Private Fare basis codes
All fares in this corporate deal are based on published fares.MCA routes include EUR, MEA, AFR2, SIN, MY, TH, NZ
